comparison_points.reason: The simplified form reaches unity on each independently normalised load axis. This algebraic endpoint agreement does not establish the capacity definitions or a mixed-load criterion.

Independent zero-pressure, unit-factor, perfectly plastic thin-ring equilibrium gives a cosine interaction rather than a circle. The simplified unity boundary permits 22.5 % more moment at half the plastic tension in this idealised counterexample.
